mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for AI overviews optimization for a plastic surgery practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for AI overviews optimization varies significantly based on the scope of work. Factors include the current state of your website's content and technical SEO, the number of procedures you want to highlight, and the competitiveness of your local market. Packages can range from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per month, often bundled with broader digital marketing services. A custom quote provides the most accurate estimate after an initial assessment.
